hero.title: Mia Calendar Capture
hero.subtitle: Invite in. Event saved.
hero.tagline: A Chrome MV3 extension that pastes or scrapes calendar invites and writes structured events to Firestore for the Mia Calendar agenda.
hero.impact: Scrape mode requires a real date and time and filters page-title junk (e.g. university week headers), so the agenda stays clean. Events land under users/{uid}/events with source: extension.

problems.d: Copying Google Calendar blocks into structured fields is tedious and error-prone.
Page titles look like events — scrapers must reject junk without a real when.
Captured events must appear next to manual/voice events in the Flutter agenda.
Anonymous or email/password Auth so writes satisfy Firebase security without a full OAuth flow.
